messages:
Eileen R: Starting a focused thread for Partner Q: they require an EU-staged launch with holdback cohorts, strict telemetry ledger, and a hard-swap toggle that can flip traffic out of region instantly. Need owners and a concise playbook.
Tom S: My take: adopt a 3-phase holdback: cohort A (2% random) -> cohort B (15% eu-only) -> cohort C (50% eu hold). Each phase needs a shadow slice to NA for 24h. No marketing promos during windows.
Hannah K: Ops constraints: hard-swap must route to `global-safe` within 15s and preserve request ordering when possible. We need a validated route table and a manual override in Console.
Carlos M: Perf notes: pin to `pq_partnerq.eu.v1` (quantized). Pre-warm caches and GPU kernels 30m before phase start. Reserve +30% burst for first 3h of any ramp.
Eileen R: Telemetry contract asks: per-tenant latency histogram, per-route 5xx, token-cost delta, and a daily sample set of up to 150 sanitized requests for first 72h. They want a signed ledger (SLA appendix) and a webhook to their staging Slack.
LegalBot: Legal requires a DPA addendum and explicit consent for sample sharing. Samples retained max 7 days; aggregates 90 days. PII must be scrubbed and hash identifiers.
Tom S: Flag naming: `pq.partnerq.eu.holdback.v1`. Proposed canary JSON (for Console import):
```
{"holdback": [{"name":"A","slice":"rand-2pct","duration":"2h"},{"name":"B","slice":"eu-15pct","duration":"12h","shadow":"na-24h"},{"name":"C","slice":"eu-50pct","duration":"24h"}], "hard_swap_target":"model-global-safe","prewarm_mins":30}
```
Hannah K: Rollback/hard-swap rules: auto-swap if ANY of: 1) 5xx rate >1% sustained 120s, 2) p95 latency exceeds baseline +1.2s for 3m, 3) customer eval delta >5% on gold set. Auto sequence: disable new slices -> hard-swap -> scale down variant -> page SRE. Manual hard-swap available in Console for oncall.
Carlos M: Quality gate detail: customer must provide a 1k prompt gold set; we run daily evaluation during holdback. If the eval shows drift >5% for 2 consecutive runs we trigger rollback. We need an agreed sample quorum before escalations.
Eileen R: Owners recap: Product drafts SLA appendix & sample schema; Eng-Platform builds flag + webhook + prewarm; SRE authors hard-swap automation + SLOs; Ops validates route tables and runs cutover. Legal to sign DPA.
ops-bot: Note: block marketing campaigns tagged `partnerq` during holdback windows. Pre-auth emergency scale +40% active for first 6h.
Hannah K: Schedule proposal: run staging rehearsal Tuesday 09:00 UTC (kill/hard-swap tests), then production kickoff Thursday 08:00 UTC pending signoffs. Please confirm by Monday EOD.
deploy-bot: checkpoint created: holdback-playbooks/partnerq-eu/1812349999 by Eileen R
Eileen R: Final asks: Product share SLA appendix draft by Friday; Eng-Platform deliver flag + sanitized schema; SRE post hard-swap runbook and staging test logs; Ops confirm route table and emergency scale. Everyone please react with :thumbsup: to approve.
